title: Ding Labing metung a batuin a miyugse
intro: Ing metung a pigura ibat keng Quran midinan yang malalam a vision inyang kayanakan na — metung a pangarap a celestial bodies a makalukluk bilang kagalangan. Dakal a banua ing milabas keng pamagtaksil, pamikawani, maling akusasyon, ampo pangasukul bayu ya maging tutu ing vision ayni. Ninu ining matatag a kaladwa na ing istorya na ing pekamakabang chapter ning Quran?
clues: Minsan kayanakan ku pa, binindisyunan naku ning metung a makabaldugan a pangarap na pati ing sarili kung tata pepabalu na kanaku na itago ku.
Ding mismung kapatad ku, mebulag la uli na ning diria, migplanu lang laban kanaku at inugse da ku king malalam at madalumdum a talaga.
Dela da ku king marayung bansa at pisali da ku king pibalebale na ning metung a marangal a opisyal, nung nu ku menakit pabor at tinas ing katungkulan.
Ing maling akusasyon ing meging sangkan ning kanakung e makatuliran a pangasukul, dapot king madalumdum a lugal a ita menakit kung kapayapan king pamanalangin at pamagsuku king Allah.

Bendisyunan naku ning Allah king pambihirang abilidad a mag-interpret kareng paninap, a king bandang tauli migdala kanaku king arap ning pamuntuk ning bansa at tinas na ku king matas a katungkulan ning kapanaligan.

Kaybat ning makabang banuang pamikawani, mibalik ku kareng pakamalan kung pamilya, at ing kanakung pangarap inyang anak ku na labing metung a batuin, ing aldo, at ing bulan a makaduku kanaku, metupad na.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
